verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly positions itself as an AI control layer with AgentControl configs, so consuming MCP tools is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents only LaunchDarkly's own MCP server, which external AI clients like Cursor or Claude Code connect to. That is the server role and does not show LaunchDarkly plugging in MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows any MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
